text:
alex: Heads-up — Dovetail (tenant dovetail-prod) is seeing recurring P95 latency spikes and intermittent 429s on their Dedicated pool (eu2-dedicated-2). Symptoms line up with noisy-neighbor GPU contention on shared nodes; they report bursts when jobs pack into fractional MIG slices.

mia: Can you paste the pool + slice IDs and a short repro? also any recent deploys or config changes? :thinking_face:

alex: Pool: eu2-dedicated-2, node id: node-43, slice config: 1g.7gb (fractional MIG). Customer load: steady concurrency ~8, prompt length ~120 tokens, response size ~300 tokens. Autoscaler didn't add capacity during the spike window (logs attached).

alex: Repro steps they shared:
```
# stress repro (from their side)
for i in {1..8}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"llama-3-large","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":300}' &
done
wait
```

alex: Observed on our side: p95 token latency jumps from ~120ms -> ~900ms, 429 rate ~3-5% for ~3-5 minutes, GPU SM util oscillation, KV cache miss ratio spikes, and elevated L3 cache evictions. No recent customer deployments.

dev-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-3497 — noisy neighbor contention (eu2-dedicated-2 / node-43). Assigned: ops_liam. :rotating_light:

ops_liam: Looking. Can we get the exact timestamps and the relevant host-side logs? also need the tenant slot id (slot-UUID) so we can correlate to MIG slice.

alex: Timestamps: 2026-03-09T14:02:06Z -> 2026-03-09T14:08:41Z. Slot id: slot-7b9f2c. Attaching upload link to perf traces and node telemetry: https://artifacts.internal/repro/slot-7b9f2c/trace.tar.gz

sre_jen: From the traces: we see repeated preemption-like stalls on node-43 and a pattern where sibling slices briefly consume high SM and memory bandwidth, then drop. Looks like fractional MIG packing fragmentation: multiple tiny slices scheduled back-to-back cause L3/TX contention. Also KV cache cold-starts on the affected tenant.

sre_jen: Quick mitigation options: 1) live-migrate slot-7b9f2c to an isolated node (available spare in eu2), 2) temporarily increase tenant concurrency throttling to smooth bursts, or 3) reconfigure autoscale to prefer adding full-node capacity rather than more fractional slices.

mia: Can we try 1) + 2) immediately, and 3) as a longer term config change? Customer is seeing production impact.

ops_liam: Actioned migration to spare node-58 at 2026-03-09T14:12:03Z, routing updated. Also applied soft throttling to dovetail-prod requests to concurrency 6 while we monitor. Confirming with the customer now.

alex: Customer reports p95 back down to ~140ms, 429s dropped to 0. They can repro the previous load and no spike so far. :thumbsup:

eng_sam: Follow-ups: we should add a heuristic in the packer to avoid co-locating high-variance tenants into adjacent fractional slices on the same physical node. Filing an engineering ticket ENGR-1294 for packing policy + autoscaler tuning notes. Also capture a postmortem with the customer's repro set.

mia: Thanks everyone. ops_liam please keep the customer in the loop and schedule a follow-up next week to discuss reserved full-node option (Dedicated capacity) to avoid fractional contention.

ops_liam: Will do — keeping INC-2026-3497 open until we validate 24h of stable metrics. Marking this thread for handoff to eng_sam for the packing policy work. :white_check_mark:
